tasks.name: review

intent.goal: Review this code for bugs, edge cases, and security issues.

tasks.baseline: Please review the following code very carefully for any and all bugs, edge cases, security vulnerabilities, and potential improvements. For each issue you find, provide a thorough explanation, the severity level, and a concrete suggested fix. Be comprehensive. {{code}}

tasks.name: testgen

intent.goal: Write unit tests for this function.

tasks.baseline: Write a comprehensive and thorough set of unit tests for the following function. Make sure to cover all of the important edge cases, error conditions, and boundary values, and use the standard, idiomatic testing framework for the language. {{code}}

tasks.name: security-audit

intent.goal: Perform a security audit of this code.

tasks.baseline: Conduct a thorough and detailed security audit of the following code. Identify every exploitable vulnerability you can find, map each one to its corresponding CWE identifier, rank them all by severity from critical to low, and provide a remediation recommendation for each. {{code}}
